nonfindings: The facing validator bounds component count and resolved-ID uniqueness before resolving direction dependencies; generated/label identities and missing opposed_to are supported, not bugs in themselves.
A mapped geology window uses EPSG:3034 metre rectangles, while fault traces use WGS84 points; the specialized validator branch is not evidence of an automatic geographic-bounds omission.
